# dsh-any-background
English | 中文
A **DeepSeek Harness** appearance plugin: custom theme color, background wallpaper (image / video /
algorithmically generated), and per-surface opacity & blur control. Compatible with **DSH `0.2.0-rc.
1` through `0.2.2-rc.1` — and every host release above it**.
## Screenshots
Custom homepage · wallpaper + theme color applied
Theme color picker · PS-style wheel + HSL/RGB inputs
Per-surface opacity and blur
Background editor · pan and zoom
Generated background · mesh gradient / Shader / geometric
Generated background · geometric low-poly
Export and import configs to share them
## Features
### Color & theme
- **PS-style color wheel** — Hue on the ring, saturation and lightness in the inscribed square; gene

rates 30+ CSS design tokens live.
- **Precise HSL / RGB input** — Numeric entry, bidirectionally syn

ced with the wheel.
- **Smart extraction / eyedropper** — One click derives a theme color from the w
allpaper (sampling the visible area and discarding gray, near-black and near-white), or hover any pi

xel to pick it. Video wallpapers contribute an auto-captured frame. All client-side.
- **Forced ligh
t / dark scheme** — Light, dark or auto. In auto the surface and font direction follow the accent co
lor's lightness (dark pick → light text), falling back to the wallpaper's brightness when no accent

is set.
- **Theme export / import** — A self-contained `dsh-any-theme.json` (config + wallpaper + th

e whole rotation pool) that restores anywhere.
- **Presets & profiles** — Six one-click presets plus
named profiles that can be renamed and duplicated; deleting asks for confirmation twice.
### Background & wallpaper

- **Image wallpaper** — Upload any image as the background.
- **Video wallpaper** — Muted, looping,
survives refreshes (persisted on disk + HTTP Range streaming), with one frame captured for the previ

ew, color extraction and position editing.
- **Position editor & layout modes** — Drag to pan, scrol
l or pinch to zoom, one-click reset; Fit / Fill / Stretch / Tile / Center. Image and video placement

s are stored separately and never overwrite each other.
- **Generated backgrounds** — Mesh gradient,

Shader or geometric patterns, with adjustable spread and intensity and a lockable seed.
- **Wallpap
er rotation** — Build a pool with the thumbnail picker and rotate by shuffle or order, on every refr

esh / hourly / daily / weekly; the cadence advances while the page stays open, not only on reload.
-
**Day / night switch** — A day profile and a night profile, switched on a fixed schedule or by foll
owing the OS dark mode.
### Per-surface opacity & blur
- **Eleven parts, each with its own slider pair** — main background, sidebar, card panels, input & c
ontrols, settings panel, conversation frame, trajectory view, right sidebar (or bettersidebar), prod

uced / highlighted content, header popovers, and the header bar.
- **The slider IS the frost amount,
and 0 means no frost** — including over the host's own default menu frost. Every part still **defau

lts to 30px**, so a stock install keeps the frosted look.
- **Opacity re-scopes the host's own token

** — it never stacks a second color over the original, so the wallpaper shows through the content.
-
**Produced / highlighted content shares one slider** — code blocks (with their language banner), in

line `code` chips and produced chips move together.
- **Right sidebar / bettersidebar: one pair, two
identities** — without dsh-better-sidebar it drives the official right sidebar; with it installed t
he same pair takes over that plugin's bottom workbench panel (the official sidebar keeps responding

too).
- **On the Windows desktop shell it also drives the caption band** — the sidebar pair paints t
he segment directly above the sidebar, and the cut follows the sidebar's width as it is dragged or c
ollapsed (at width 0 the band returns to the header card). The 「标题栏」 card drives the rest of the ban
d and the native window controls, with a four-state 「标题条带文字」 choice (auto / follow theme / always wh
ite / always black) for when a light strip fights the theme.
## Compatibility
- **`dsh web`: `0.2.0-rc.1` ~ `0.2.2-rc.1`, and everything above it.** The gate names each build tha
t was checked and then closes with an uncapped `>=0.2.0-rc.1`. That umbrella is deliberate: the host
enforces exactly this peer list — a release it does not name is disabled before a single module is
imported — so a range that runs out is a wall in front of a plugin that would have kept working. (Mo
re precisely: the host's `app-boot` `unmetRequirements` reads `engines.dsh` alone when that field is
present and ignores peerDependencies, so all four places must say the same thing but `engines.dsh`

is what actually decides whether the plugin loads.)
- **How an unseen build runs**: it gets the clos
est verified set of facts plus a log line saying how far from `exact` that is. The worst a stale fac
t can cost is one slider no longer fading a surface the host has since moved; a version check that f

ailed closed would cost the whole plugin.
- **Verified builds** (`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`):
| Host build | Facts folder | Notes |

| `0.2.0-rc.1` | `v0-2-0-rc-1` | verified by diffing its tag, package by package |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` |
`v0-2-0-rc-2` | same; this rc renamed the token a sticky menu group heading paints from, so it opene

d its own facts |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` ~ `0.2.1-rc.5` | `v0-2-1` | facts unchanged, folded into one fol
der; every checked build gets its own row with an `exact` verdict. `rc.4` and `rc.5` ship artifacts

byte-identical to `rc.3`, file by file |
| `0.2.2-alpha.2` | `v0-2-2` | a new patch line, so its own
facts folder; every claim re-read and still true (z-index ladder, menu frost tokens, font token com

position, header slot keys, 75 host selectors matching) |
| `0.2.2-rc.1` | `v0-2-2` | **checked on a
real host**: gate / RPC / boot self-check all pass; every rule input still hits across 98 artifacts

, three moved evidence literals recorded in the adapter; `exact` verdict |
| above `0.2.2-rc.1` | re
uses the closest row | an unverified build takes that line's adapter, stated in the log |
